he.118:
צִדְקָתְךָ צֶֽדֶק לְעוֹלָם וְתוֹרָתְךָ אֱמֶת׃
וְצִדְקָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים עַד־מָרוֹם, אֲשֶׁר־עָשִֽׂיתָ גְדֹלוֹת
אֱלֹהִים, מִי כָמֽוֹךָ׃
צִדְקָתְךָ כְּהַרְרֵי־אֵל, מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ תְּהוֹם רַבָּה
אָדָם וּבְהֵמָה תוֹשִֽׁיעַ יהוה׃

en.117: The following is omitted on days when Taḥanun is not said (see page 232).
en.118:
צִדְקָתְךָ Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness,
and Your Torah is truth.
Your righteousness, O God, reaches to the highest heights,
for You have done great things.
O God, who is like You?
Your righteousness is like the mighty mountains;
Your judgments like the great depths.
O LORD, You save both man and beast.
